purpose: Replace the rejected Flat and coarse SMC proxy generators with an explicit multi-timeframe dealing-range state machine derived from the user's strategy materials.

scope.trade_style: trend-aligned movement inside active 1D/4H dealing ranges

entry_paths.raid: fresh closed H1 liquidity raid -> later confirmed 5m BOS with correct raid geometry -> next aligned 15m open
entry_paths.vc: closed H1 volume confirmation after HTF POI contact -> new H1 VC zone -> later closed 15m zone test -> later confirmed 5m BOS -> next aligned 15m open

scope.entry_execution: the 5m BOS must be fully closed; execution uses only the next aligned 15m bar open and never its future high, low, close or volume
scope.stop: raid path behind the swept fresh liquidity; VC path behind the structural Strong Low/High or POI invalidation
scope.target: valid liquidity or FTA on the originating context timeframe, including weak extremes, EQH/EQL, BSL/SSL, FVG/IMB objectives and dealing-range boundaries

timeframe_roles.1M: broad secular scenario and PMH/PML liquidity; context only, never a direct entry trigger
timeframe_roles.1W: primary long-horizon scenario, external structure and PWH/PWL liquidity
timeframe_roles.1D: active higher-timeframe bias, protected/weak extremes, PDH/PDL, major POI and dealing range
timeframe_roles.4H: tradable dealing range, internal/external structure, level map and directional narrative
timeframe_roles.1H: fresh fractal raid or volume confirmation that creates a new lower-timeframe POI
timeframe_roles.15M: test of an H1 VC-created POI, risk/target validation and next-open execution
timeframe_roles.5M: confirmed pivot/fractal structure, IDM and body-close BOS trigger

sources: active 1D/4H dealing-range weak and protected extremes
strength_factors: distance to opposing liquidity and target space
liquidity_map.rule: A level can define context, POI, FTA, stop or target, but can never replace the required confirmation and 5m trigger chain.

hard_invariants: All features use only fully closed source candles.
A pivot/fractal becomes available only after all right-side confirmation candles have closed.
Monthly, weekly, daily and intraday resampling exposes only complete calendar buckets.
The direct raid path requires a fresh confirmed H1 fractal, a wick sweep and a close back inside.
The VC path requires a closed H1 displacement with elevated volume and either a new imbalance or confirmed BOS after HTF POI contact.
An H1 VC-created POI requires a later closed 15m test and directional rejection before 5m BOS can be accepted.
A simple H1 reaction candle is diagnostic and cannot arm an entry.
A wick-only 5m break is not BOS; the signal must close beyond a pivot known before the signal opened.
No setup may skip state-machine stages from context to POI to confirmation to 5m trigger to 15m execution.
No new entry during a high-impact event blackout.
No entry when structural invalidation cannot produce the preregistered minimum RR to a valid target.
No symbol, period, threshold or rule changes after viewing a development result.

soft_layers.principle: Hard invariants protect causality and invalidation; market quality is represented by continuous scores rather than a large collection of brittle binary filters.
trend_strength: distance and cleanliness of protected versus weak extremes
number and quality of directional BOS events
slope and persistence of the active dealing range
level_strength: FVG/IMB, SNR, RB or OB confluence
distance to opposing liquidity and target space

event_risk.provider_contract: Providers normalize into immutable scheduled events; API keys are read from environment variables and never committed.
event_risk.backtest_contract: Historical research must use a frozen point-in-time event snapshot with acquisition timestamps. A current API response may not reconstruct what was known historically.
event_risk.estimated_crypto_event_rule: Estimated dates cannot create an intraday hard blackout; they may only reduce quality until a precise timestamp is available.
event_risk.news_sentiment_rule: Unscheduled news remains observational until a timestamped historical archive proves that it improves strict OOS results. It cannot silently become a directional oracle.

implementation_phases.name: NEW_DEVELOPMENT_SCREEN
implementation_phases.gate: PF >= 1.20, positive average return, >=60% positive folds, DD <=8%

implementation_phases.name: UNTOUCHED_HOLDOUT
deliverables: exactly one frozen leader on one never-used period
implementation_phases.gate: positive holdout, PF >1.10 with target >=1.20, positive average return and at least half positive folds

anti_overfit_rules: The old 2025-01-01 through 2026-06-30 development period remains exposed and cannot serve as the external holdout.
Recognition errors are fixed against definitions and labelled examples, not against PnL.
Only a small candidate set may be preregistered after the recognition layer is stable.
News and calendar layers are tested as independent ablations.
VPS, paper promotion and live execution remain prohibited.
